start:
@startuml
actor user
participant app
user -> app: pay
alt [approved]
  app --> user: receipt
else [declined]
end
@enduml

after.text:
@startuml
actor user
participant app
user -> app: pay
alt [approved]
else [declined]
  app --> user: receipt
end

uml-pg-status.text: Drag a highlighted element. Tab to focus, arrows to nudge, Delete to remove.

uml-pg-class-selection.text: Select one class to edit its name or members.

after.properties:
- region "Relation — app → user":
  - heading "Relation — app → user" [level=2]
  - button "✕ Delete"
  - text: Type
  - combobox "Type":
    - option "Synchronous"
    - option "Asynchronous"
    - option "Return" [selected]
    - option "Create"
    - option "Lost"
    - option "Found"
  - text: Source endpoint
  - combobox "Source endpoint":
    - option "user"
    - option "app" [selected]
  - text: Target endpoint
  - combobox "Target endpoint":
    - option "user" [selected]
    - option "app"
  - text: Label
  - textbox "Label": receipt
  - button "Invert direction"
  - group "Message order":
    - text: Message order
    - button "Move earlier"
    - button "Move later"
  - text: Branch
  - combobox "Branch":
    - 'option "1: alt [approved]"'
    - 'option "2: else [declined]" [selected]'
  - paragraph: Drag a message line up or down to reorder it, or press Delete to remove it.
  - button "Add teaching callout"
